_notes.Edit(**/Configs/*.local.*): S4-4c-1 (owner, 2026-11-05): only the owner writes Configs/Signing.local.xcconfig, which the unsandboxed xcodegen and xcodebuild read; no normal step (commit, branch, fetch, push, git worktree add or remove for /review-pr, build, tests, npm, the installer) writes it, so the rule adds no prompt. Its class (owner, 2026-11-06, PR #46 round 1: the tracked Configs/Signing.xcconfig, project.yml and the generated MoonShine.xcodeproj, writable by a session and read by the unsandboxed build) is closed by H1c: the build runs only through the installed xcbuild, which runs main's check first and generates the project afresh. What H1c leaves open is in CLAUDE.md § Git.
_notes.Bash(/Users/<you>/.config/moonshine/bin/: H1c (owner, 2026-11-06): the only way to build or test the app. The guard installer writes it from main's scripts/xcbuild.sh and scripts/check-project-scripts.mjs, outside the checkout where a session cannot write; it clears the environment, checks project.yml, the signing settings and the build tree, removes and generates MoonShine.xcodeproj, pins the packages and runs xcodebuild with fixed flags. It runs outside the sandbox (excludedCommands) like xcodebuild did. Bare xcodegen and xcodebuild have no allow and no exclusion and are denied: a session's copy would run inside the sandbox, where it cannot escape, and the deny refuses it at once. Reinstall the guard after a merged change to either script; the build warns when the checkout's copy differs, and never runs it.
_notes.gh pr list: H1c (owner, 2026-11-06): read the open PRs before creating one. Outside the sandbox for the same reason as gh pr view: inside it, gh cannot read its own config and login in the home folder.
_notes.xcrun xcresulttool get test-results: H1c (owner, 2026-11-06): the app test summary, read from DerivedData/Logs/Test/*.xcresult in two calls (CLAUDE.md → Commands). Outside the sandbox because it writes to the system temporary folder (PR #45). It parses only .xcresult bundles, so a path outside the repository can yield only such a bundle's content.
_notes.gh run view, gh run list: H1c (owner, 2026-11-06): read CI runs. Outside the sandbox like gh pr view (gh's config and login in the home folder).

_worktreeOnly._note: Only for a parallel author session's sibling worktree ../moonshine-<n>, which the owner creates (CLAUDE.md § Git). In that worktree's copy, merge these entries into permissions.deny and sandbox.filesystem, fill in the placeholders with the main checkout's path (except `<repo>` in env.npm_config_cache, which is the checkout this file lives in: the worktree may write only its own folder), and delete this key; in the main checkout's copy, just delete it. Never commit a real path: the owner's home path is on the deny-list.
